trials.claim: All future Company or Enterprise Plan updates are included
trials.claimQuote: All future Company (Tiers 1-2) or Enterprise (Tiers 3-7) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The prosecution exhibits complain about a transaction fee and a one-store limit, but neither shows that future Company or Enterprise Plan updates were withheld or charged for separately.

exhibits.quote: my total profit is 2% on my product sale, Here how can i divide it 1% with SELLDONE, whereas i also pay Higher Enterprise Plan Fee $330
exhibits.argument: Quote shows Enterprise buyers still pay a 1% transaction fee on top of the lifetime fee, undermining the claim that all future Enterprise Plan updates are fully included without extra cost.

exhibits.quote: Product description very misleading for $329 highest tier I thought i would be able to host multiple store at a Enterprize level turns out this deal at the highest tier is still only for one store
exhibits.argument: Quote shows the highest tier does not include multiple Enterprise-level stores as implied, contradicting the promise of all future Enterprise Plan updates being included.

trials.claim: Store can be built and scaled with 1500+ native features without plugins or coding
trials.claimQuote: Build, manage, and scale your online store with 1,500+ native features—no plugins or coding required
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms marketplace, POS, CMS, subscriptions, digital delivery, affiliates and discounts are all native with no add-ons or plugins. The missing order-edit and bundle features noted by others do not show plugins or coding are required.

exhibits.quote: You currently can't edit existing orders directly to add or remove products post-purchase.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows core order-management capability is missing natively and requires workarounds, contradicting the claim of 1500+ native features with no plugins or coding required.

exhibits.quote: There is no native product bundle feature to combine multiple items into a single kit with individual product inventory tracking.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows a standard e-commerce feature is not natively available, undermining the claim that the store can be built and scaled with native features alone.

exhibits.quote: Marketplace builder, POS, CMS + blog, subscriptions, digital file delivery, affiliates and discounts — all native. No add-ons, no plugins.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms store can be built with many native features and explicitly states no add-ons/plugins required.

trials.claim: Launch on custom domain with cloud hosting, SSL and CDN included
trials.claimQuote: Launch on your own custom domain with cloud hosting, SSL certification, and CDN (content delivery network) included
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms building a store with a custom domain with SSL on the platform. One support issue involving Cloudflare guidance does not show custom domain, SSL, hosting or CDN were not included.

exhibits.quote: When I ran into a domain/SSL issue, he responded incredibly fast in the support chat and pointed me in exactly the right direction (Cloudflare integration) to get it sorted.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows SSL/custom-domain setup required external Cloudflare integration and support intervention, contradicting the claim that SSL and hosting are seamlessly included.

exhibits.quote: After actually building things out, products, categories, discount codes, custom domain with SSL, page builder, product variants and SKUs I've been really impressed by how much this platform can do!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms they built store using custom domain with SSL as included native capability.

trials.claim: Built-in CMS and blog for publishing and managing content natively
trials.claimQuote: Publish and manage content natively with a built-in CMS (content management system) and blog
trials.reasoning: A buyer directly lists CMS + blog among the platform's native features, with no add-ons or plugins needed.

exhibits.quote: Marketplace builder, POS, CMS + blog, subscriptions, digital file delivery, affiliates and discounts — all native. No add-ons, no plugins.
exhibits.argument: Quote directly lists CMS + blog as native built-in features, supporting the claim.

trials.claim: Previous AppSumo customers are grandfathered into new features and limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into any new features and feature limits
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were provided about previous AppSumo customers being grandfathered, so the claim cannot be checked either way.
